comment: Cross-language fixture. Synthetic — contains no corpus data. Regenerate with `./gradlew -q fixture`; both implementations must reproduce it.

cases.name: relevance-only
cases.why: the shipped default: plain cosine, everything else off

cases.name: park-baseline
cases.why: the literature baseline, reproduced exactly

cases.name: all-four-terms
cases.why: every term weighted, including salience

cases.name: tie-break-on-serial
cases.why: m01 and m02 are identical to the scorer except serial; the newer must win

cases.name: degenerate-minmax
cases.why: k=1 leaves one candidate, so every term normalises to zero and the score is 0

cases.name: recency-park-halflife
cases.why: at 5.8 days the term underflows for nearly everything — the pathology, pinned

cases.name: recency-91-days
cases.why: the default half-life, where the term is a real curve

cases.name: scope-companion-lena
cases.why: lena may see her own fiction and nobody else's

cases.name: scope-agnostic-sees-no-fiction
cases.why: an asker who is nobody must reach no IN_WORLD memory at all

cases.name: scope-owner-partition
cases.why: another person's conversations are excluded

cases.name: scope-superseded
cases.why: 'was true until March' is returned only when asked for

cases.name: scope-all-kinds
cases.why: no kind filter: the observation becomes reachable

cases.name: multiplier-1
cases.why: a narrow candidate set: the other terms never get a vote

cases.name: multiplier-4
cases.why: a wide one: same k, different answer

cases.name: k-exceeds-candidates
cases.why: asking for more than exists is not an error

cases.name: int8-rounding-halves
cases.why: components landing on exactly ±0.5 before rounding

cases.name: non-unit-query
cases.why: a query that is not unit length must be normalised first

cases.name: dense-vectors
cases.why: every component non-zero and inexact: exercises float32 rounding in unitised and accumulation order in the exact rescore

cases.name: dense-vectors-relevance-only
cases.why: the same vectors under plain cosine, where nothing masks a precision drift

cases.name: narrow-importance-spread
cases.why: importance is float in Java and double in JS; min-max amplifies the gap by 1/(hi-lo) and this spread is small enough for it to matter

cases.name: empty-result
cases.why: a scope admitting nothing returns nothing, not an error

cases.name: world-scope-a
cases.why: a caller in world-a sees world-a's memories and the player's, never world-b's

cases.name: world-scope-b
cases.why: the same query from world-b returns a disjoint set of world memories

cases.name: world-scope-none
cases.why: no world -- the browser -- reaches person memories only, never a save's
